item.title: Palmer: Verstappen-Mercedes talks inevitable as Red Bull struggles
item.description: F1 TV commentator Jolyon Palmer believes that Max Verstappen is rapidly approaching a career crossroads that leads straight to Mercedes.

item.title: Haas car gets monster livery as team brings Godzilla to Suzuka
item.description: At Suzuka this week, the TGR Haas F1 team has decided to bring one of cinema’s most iconic beasts roaring onto the grid.

item.title: Hadjar: F1’s April break could hurt as much as help Red Bull
item.description: The Formula 1 paddock is bracing for an unusual silence this April – and for Red Bull Racing, it’s a hiatus that cuts both ways.

item.title: Why Sainz is racing in fear of ‘a very big crash’ in F1
item.description: Carlos Sainz believes that Formula 1 may be hurtling toward a high-speed disaster of its own making due to its new regulations.

item.title: When Senna's gain was matched by his pain
item.description: What looked like a casual Sunday drive by Senna in Brazil in 1991 turned out to be perhaps the great Brazilian's most heroic effort.

item.title: Mercedes ready to bite in Suzuka with striking ‘Wolf’ wing
item.description: It’s not a tribute to Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff – but something far more primal that the team will showcase in Suzuka.

item.title: Marko reveals Newey ‘not doing well’ at Aston Martin
item.description: Former Red Bull motorsport adviser Helmut Marko claims that Adrian Newey is “not doing well” at Aston Martin.

item.title: Honda making progress but vibration issues linger ahead of Suzuka

item.title: The ‘long conversation’ that may have led to Wheatley’s Audi exit
item.description: The sudden exit of Jonathan Wheatley from Audi last week has ignited a storm of speculation that refuses to die down.

item.title: Alonso to join Japanese GP weekend late – for the best of reasons
item.description: Fernando Alonso is set to arrive late to the Japanese Grand Prix weekend at Suzuka, choosing to remain at home a little longer.

item.title: ‘Astonished’ Wolff slams fresh Verstappen-to-Mercedes speculation
item.description: Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff has made it crystal clear that talk of Max Verstappen joining the Brackley squad is, in his words, “silly.”

item.title: Verstappen warms up for Suzuka with Super GT test at Fuji
item.description: On his way to Suzuka for this weekend’s Japanese GP, Max Verstappen made an unexpected pitstop at Fuji Speedway to test a Nissan Z GT500.

item.title: Rookie Brundle joins the big time in Brazil
item.description: On this day in 1984, Martin Brundle made his F1 debut at the Brazilian Grand Prix with Tyrrell, achieving a remarkable P5 finish.

item.title: Cadillac looking to build in Japan on team’s ‘strong foundation’
item.description: Cadillac arrive at the Japanese Grand Prix looking to build on a productive weekend in Shanghai, where both cars crossed the finish line.

item.title: Wolff warns Antonelli: One win means nothing without more
item.description: Toto Wolff is making one thing clear: Kimi Antonelli’s historic maiden victory in China last time out was a beginning, not a destination.
